title: fix: stop rereading settled session accounting
body:
Related: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/119720

## What Problem This Solves

Session accounting can keep loading and decoding up to 512 transcript bodies after finding the latest usage and current-turn taint boundary. Large payloads turn that unnecessary work into synchronous database and decompression overhead.

## User Impact

Accounting stops reading bodies once all requested facts settle. Native SQLite regressions demonstrate three required body reads instead of 512 for the covered tail, while preserving usage, taint, branch selection and the conservative candidate limit. Required-body or navigation corruption still fails conservatively; unrelated older body corruption does not invalidate settled accounting.

## Why This Change Was Made

Select the bounded path from compact navigation before lazily reading bodies. The shared reducer stops iteration when finished; resident and durable readers share the selection/reduction policy. Only imported duplicate-ID paths whose logical order differs from physical order buffer their bounded selected set.

History and accounting now share exact navigation parsing, retaining only selected navigation fields. Missing parent fields stay distinct from explicit invalid parents. Escaped Unicode and deep SQLite inputs retain their bounded raw parsing path; literal NUL corruption fails conservatively. This repairs the initial plaintext-retention finding without retaining complete candidate bodies.

No schema, configuration, cache, retention or authorization changes. Production delta: +116 lines; tests: +329. The production growth establishes lazy payload ownership and consolidates navigation handling across the two readers.

## Evidence

**Normal PR CI passed** on [run 44472302728](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44472302728): 37 successful jobs, 28 explicitly skipped, zero failures. Preflight verified merge `60fd00eb72dd2555173f21e0dd7dec17ac09f407`, combining source `192f0bf877d41c78790d51e60796e9ce9327735b` with main `01d20365e2ce5b57aa61114207712048d9365975`. Build, types, lint, changed-code runtime tests, baseline ratchets, UI E2E and all PostgreSQL conformance/smoke jobs passed.

Direct source-head Node receipts also establish **79 passing cases across all four targeted files**:

| Target | Passing cases | CI job |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `session-transcript-projection-facts.test.ts` | 25 | [133931381167](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44051511179/job/133931381167) |
| `session-accessor.sqlite-bounded-context.test.ts` | 23 | [133931365199](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44051511179/job/133931365199) |
| `session-actor-memory-history.test.ts` | 16 | [133931381238](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44051511179/job/133931381238) |
| `session-transcript-readers.test.ts` | 15 | [133931365446](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44051511179/job/133931365446) |

- Native SQLite cases passed for compressed/plaintext/escaped-Unicode suffix reads, compact navigation, native payload evaluation, query ordering, early iterator cleanup, 511/512 taint bounds, duplicate/parentless/escaped IDs, corruption, snapshot matching and reader fences. Actor-memory retained-window accounting also passed.
- Scoped independent autoreview passed for the navigation repair and final compile correction. [Fresh ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200497#issuecomment-6942989393) covers exact source `192f0bf...` and reports no actionable code findings; the earlier plaintext-retention finding is addressed.
- Native formatter, syntax checks and `git diff --check` passed. Direct SQLite probes checked literal NUL and lone-surrogate behavior.
- Historical [full manual run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44051511179) remains failed: 230 successful, 26 failed, 5 cancelled, 11 skipped. The 79 cases above were individually verified in its logs; the reader-test job failed elsewhere. Several worker/history failures remain unattributed. The new normal run is separate evidence, not a reclassification of that failed attempt.

## Limits

The tests prove work counts and correctness at the accounting boundary. No live-server latency, deployment, end-to-end Gateway baseline/head comparison or general Bun coverage is claimed. Cold artifact-list work and the rest of the linked issue remain outside this change.
